def compress(grid):

def lattice_blocks(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    R = [i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if fill not in row]
    C = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[j]!=fill for row in grid)]
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(R,R[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c,d in zip(C,C[1:]):
            cs={grid[a][c],grid[a][d],grid[b][c],grid[b][d]}
            row.append(cs.pop() if len(cs)==1 else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def lattice_blocks(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    top2=[c for c,_ in Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(2)]
    fill=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    C=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if any(row[j] not in top2 for row in grid)]
    return [[(lambda cs: cs.pop() if len(cs)==1 else fill)({grid[a][c],grid[a][d],grid[b][c],grid[b][d]})
